```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
model_components AS (
    SELECT mb.component_id, CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'SW9-180WAL93-0190'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
explosion AS (
    SELECT component_id, qty
    FROM model_components
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cb.child_component_id, e.qty * cb.qty
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = e.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explosion e
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-192-WHT-02486'
```
```sql
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
target AS (
  SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'MOT-943-BLK-00530'
),
model AS (
  SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'AL4-120BLK95-0386'
),
explosion AS (
  -- anchor: model BOM edges
  SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
  FROM model_bom mb
  JOIN model m ON mb.model_id = m.model_id
  WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  -- recursive: component BOM edges for assemblies
  SELECT cb.child_component_id, e.qty * cb.qty
  FROM explosion e
  JOIN component c ON e.component_id = c.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = e.component_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explosion e
JOIN target t ON e.component_id = t.component_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Find the part component
part AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'LEG-407-OAK-00192'
),

-- 2. Get all completed order lines for store Amazon-US-00 in 2024
lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.line_no, ol.qty AS line_qty, o.order_date, l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-00'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2024
),

-- 3. Expand SKUs to models (non-bundle directly, bundle via items)
sku_models AS (
    SELECT l.order_id, l.line_no, l.order_date, l.line_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.model_id = sm.model_id AND sm.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = false
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l.order_id, l.line_no, l.order_date, l.line_qty, sm.model_id, bi.qty * sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id AND sk.is_bundle = true
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),

-- 4. Expand models to components via model_bom (valid on order date)
model_components AS (
    SELECT sm.order_id, sm.line_no, sm.order_date, sm.line_qty, sm.model_qty,
           mb.component_id, mb.qty AS comp_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- 5. Recursively explode assemblies via component_bom (valid on order date)
exploded AS (
    SELECT mc.order_id, mc.line_no, mc.order_date, mc.line_qty, mc.model_qty,
           mc.component_id, mc.comp_qty AS qty
    FROM model_components mc
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.order_id, e.line_no, e.order_date, e.line_qty, e.model_qty,
           cb.child_component_id, e.qty * cb.qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = e.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= e.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.line_qty * e.model_qty * e.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM exploded e
JOIN part p ON p.component_id = e.component_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- explode each SKU into its base model quantities (handling bundles)
sku_model_qty AS (
    -- non-bundle SKUs map directly to models
    SELECT s.sku_id, sm.model_id, sm.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    UNION ALL
    -- bundle SKUs: expand items, then map items to models
    SELECT b.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id, sm.model_id, (b.qty * sm.qty)::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM bundle_item b
    JOIN sales_sku it ON it.sku_id = b.item_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = it.sku_id
),

    SELECT l.sku_id, ol.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'UK'
      AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2024
),
model_units AS (
    SELECT smq.model_id, SUM(s.qty * smq.qty) AS units
    FROM sold s

    GROUP BY smq.model_id
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- start from the bundle SKU

    SELECT
        child_kind,
        child_code,
        CAST(qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND parent_code = 'BDL-UK-0139'

      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        e.child_kind,
        e.child_code,
        CAST(b.qty * e.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN (
        -- SKU -> model
        SELECT parent_kind, parent_code, child_kind, child_code, qty, valid_from, valid_to
        FROM u_composition
        WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'model'
        UNION ALL
        -- model -> component
        SELECT parent_kind, parent_code, child_kind, child_code, qty, valid_from, valid_to
        FROM u_composition
        WHERE parent_kind = 'model' AND child_kind = 'component'
        UNION ALL
        -- component -> component (sub-assemblies)

        FROM u_composition
        WHERE parent_kind = 'component' AND child_kind = 'component'

     AND e.parent_code = b.child_code
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Expand each sold SKU into the company models it contains (directly or via bundles)
exploded AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.qty AS sold_qty, s.sku_code AS root_sku
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id

paths AS (

    FROM exploded e
    UNION ALL
    -- recursive step: follow composition edges
    SELECT p.order_id, p.sold_qty, p.root_sku,
```

```sql
    -- anchor: order line -> sku (qty from order line)
    SELECT
        o.order_date,

        'sku' AS kind,

    FROM explode e
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- explode each sold SKU into (model, qty) pairs, handling bundles
sku_models AS (
    -- non-bundle SKU -> model directly
    SELECT s.sku_code AS sku_code, m.model_code AS model_code, c.qty AS qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND c.child_kind = 'model'
     AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = c.child_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    UNION ALL
    -- bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT s.sku_code, m.model_code, b.qty * c.qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition b
      ON b.parent_kind = 'sku' AND b.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND b.child_kind = 'sku'
     AND b.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= b.valid_to)
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.child_code
     AND c.child_kind = 'model'
     AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = c.child_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true
),
sold AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, SUM(ol.qty) AS units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'DE'
      AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2025
    GROUP BY l.sku_id
)
SELECT sm.model_code
FROM sold
JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = sold.sku_id
JOIN sku_models sm ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code
GROUP BY sm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(sold.units * sm.qty) DESC
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all item SKUs in the bundle with their quantities
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty as bundle_item_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON b.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE b.sku_code = 'BDL-UK-0265'
),
-- Get models for each item SKU with their quantities
item_models AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.bundle_item_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get top-level components from model BOMs
model_components AS (
    SELECT im.bundle_item_qty, im.model_qty, mb.component_id, mb.qty as component_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all component BOMs
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: start with model components
    SELECT 
        mc.bundle_item_qty,
        mc.model_qty,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.component_qty as path_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow component BOMs for assemblies
    SELECT 
        e.bundle_item_qty,
        e.model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id,
        e.path_qty * cb.qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN component c ON e.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
-- Sum up total quantity of the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.bundle_item_qty * e.model_qty * e.path_qty), 0) as total_qty
```

```sql
    FROM current_component_bom ccb
    JOIN target_component tc ON ccb.child_component_id = tc.component_id
```

```sql
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku b ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
    WHERE b.sku_code = 'BDL-US-0239'
),

    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

    SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty AS component_qty, im.model_qty, im.bundle_item_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Step 4: Recursively explode all component BOMs
all_components AS (
    -- Anchor: start with model components
    SELECT 
        mc.component_id,
        mc.component_qty * mc.model_qty * mc.bundle_item_qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: follow component BOMs for assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id,
        ac.total_qty * cb.qty
    FROM all_components ac
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ac.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

)
```

```sql
    FROM model_bom
```

```sql
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
```

```sql
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow component BOMs for assemblies
    SELECT 
        mc.model_id,
        c.child_component_id AS component_id,
        mc.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find the component_id for the part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'LEG-578-WHT-00216'
),
-- Get current date for BOM validity
current_date_val AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS d
),
-- Recursive CTE to find all parent components/assemblies that contain the target part
-- Starting from the target part, go UP through component BOMs
parent_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the target part itself
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        1 AS total_qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM component c
    CROSS JOIN target_part tp
    CROSS JOIN current_date_val cd
    WHERE c.component_id = tp.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: find parent assemblies that contain any component in the hierarchy
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id AS component_id,
        ph.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        parent.is_assembly
    FROM parent_hierarchy ph
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ph.component_id = cb.child_component_id
    JOIN component parent ON cb.parent_component_id = parent.component_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date_val cd
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= cd.d 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= cb.valid_to)
      AND ph.is_assembly = true  -- Only assemblies can be parents in component BOM
),
-- Get all components (assemblies and the part itself) that contain the target part
all_containing_components AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT component_id FROM parent_hierarchy
),
-- Find all models that use any of these components in their current BOM
models_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
    FROM model_bom mb
    CROSS JOIN current_date_val cd
    WHERE mb.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM all_containing_components)
      AND mb.valid_from <= cd.d 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Find all non-bundle SKUs that map to these models
skus_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sm.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id IN (SELECT model_id FROM models_with_part)
      AND sku.is_bundle = false
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skus_with_part
```

```sql
-- Recursive CTE to find all parent components that contain the target part at any level
part_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor: direct parents of the target part in component_bom
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id AS component_id, cb.qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN target_part tp ON cb.child_component_id = tp.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: parents of any component found so far
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id, cb.qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_hierarchy ph ON cb.child_component_id = ph.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the component_id for CAB-903-WAL-02318
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'CAB-903-WAL-02318' AND is_assembly = false
),
-- Get all component BOM edges that are current as of 2026-10-01
current_component_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all model BOM edges that are current as of 2026-10-01
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Recursive CTE to find all ancestors of the target part in component BOM
-- Starting from the target part, walk up to all parent assemblies
component_ancestors AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the target part itself
    SELECT child_component_id AS component_id, 1 AS level
    FROM target_part
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: find parents of current components
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id, ca.level + 1
    FROM component_ancestors ca
    JOIN current_component_bom cb ON ca.component_id = cb.child_component_id
),
-- All components that contain the target part (including the part itself)
all_containing_components AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT component_id FROM component_ancestors
),
-- Find all models that directly use any of these components
models_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cmb.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom cmb
    WHERE cmb.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM all_containing_components)
),
-- Find all non-bundle SKUs that map to these models
skus_from_models AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sm.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id IN (SELECT model_id FROM models_with_part)
      AND sku.is_bundle = false
),
-- Also need to check: models that use assemblies containing the part
-- The recursive CTE above handles this, but let's also consider:
-- Some models might directly use the target part as well
direct_models AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cmb.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom cmb
    JOIN target_part tp ON cmb.component_id = tp.component_id
),
-- Combine and get all SKUs
all_relevant_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id FROM skus_from_models
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sm.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id IN (SELECT model_id FROM direct_models)
```

```sql
-- A bundle can contain other bundles, so we need to recurse

    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS root_bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        bi.qty
    FROM bundle_item bi

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: if an item is itself a bundle, expand it

        bir.root_bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bir.qty * bi.qty AS qty
    FROM bundle_items_recursive bir
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = bir.item_sku_id AND ss.is_bundle = true
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = bir.item_sku_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that map directly or indirectly to model SW8-140BLK02-0002

    SELECT sm.sku_id, sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm

    WHERE cm.model_code = 'SW8-140BLK02-0002'
),
-- Bundles that contain SKUs mapping to the model (at any nesting level)
bundle_sku AS (
    -- Base: bundles containing direct SKUs
    SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id, bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN direct_sku ds ON bi.item_sku_id = ds.sku_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundles containing other bundles that eventually lead to the model
    SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id, bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty * bs.bundle_qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN bundle_sku bs ON bi.item_sku_id = bs.bundle_sku_id
```

```sql
-- First, find all SKUs that map directly to the target model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'NO5-140OAK03-0391'
),
-- Find all bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs mapping to the target model
-- Need to handle nested bundles recursively
bundle_skus_recursive AS (
    -- Base: bundles that directly contain SKUs mapping to the target model
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty as item_qty,
        sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'NO5-140OAK03-0391'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundles that contain other bundles that eventually map to the target model
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bsr.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty * bsr.item_qty as item_qty,
        bsr.model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN bundle_skus_recursive bsr ON bi.item_sku_id = bsr.bundle_sku_id
),
-- All SKUs that map to the target model, with their effective model quantity per SKU unit
all_mapping_skus AS (
    -- Direct SKUs
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty, 1.0 as bundle_multiplier
    FROM direct_skus
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs (the bundle itself is what gets sold)
    SELECT bundle_sku_id as sku_id, model_qty, item_qty as bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_skus_recursive
),
-- Get all listings for these SKUs
relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, ams.sku_id, ams.model_qty, ams.bundle_multiplier
    FROM listing l
    JOIN all_mapping_skus ams ON l.sku_id = ams.sku_id
),
-- Calculate total units sold
sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * rl.model_qty * rl.bundle_multiplier), 0) as total_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN relevant_listings rl ON ol.listing_id = rl.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2023
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all SKUs that map directly or indirectly to model CO6-140GRY29-0320
-- Direct model mappings
direct_model_skus AS (
    SELECT s.sku_id, s.sku_code, s.is_bundle, sm.qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'CO6-140GRY29-0320'
),
-- Bundles that contain SKUs mapping to the target model (directly or through other bundles)
bundle_contributions AS (
    -- Base: bundles that directly contain SKUs mapping to the model
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty as item_qty_per_bundle,
        dms.model_qty_per_sku,
        bi.qty * dms.model_qty_per_sku as total_model_qty_per_bundle
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN direct_model_skus dms ON bi.item_sku_id = dms.sku_id
    WHERE dms.is_bundle = false  -- only non-bundle items directly map to models
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundles that contain other bundles that eventually map to the model
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty as item_qty_per_bundle,
        bc.total_model_qty_per_bundle as model_qty_per_sku,
        bi.qty * bc.total_model_qty_per_bundle as total_model_qty_per_bundle
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN bundle_contributions bc ON bi.item_sku_id = bc.bundle_sku_id
),
-- All SKUs that contribute to the model, with their model quantity multiplier
contributing_skus AS (
    -- Direct mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty_per_sku as multiplier
    FROM direct_model_skus
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs that contain the model
    SELECT bundle_sku_id, total_model_qty_per_bundle as multiplier
    FROM bundle_contributions
),
-- Get all completed order lines in 2023 for these SKUs
order_lines_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2023
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * cs.multiplier), 0) as total_units_sold
FROM order_lines_2023 ol
JOIN contributing_skus cs ON ol.sku_id = cs.sku_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the model_id for AL9-120BLK52-0634
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id 
    FROM company_model 
    WHERE model_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634'
),

-- Find all SKUs that directly map to this model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_model
    WHERE model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
),

-- Find all bundle SKUs that contain items mapping to this model
-- Need to find: bundles -> their item SKUs -> those item SKUs' models
-- Recursive: bundles can contain other bundles
bundle_skus AS (
    -- Anchor: item SKUs that directly map to target model
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.qty as bundle_item_qty,
        sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundles that contain other bundles
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.qty * bs.bundle_item_qty as bundle_item_qty,
        bs.model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN bundle_skus bs ON bi.item_sku_id = bs.bundle_sku_id
),

-- All SKUs that ultimately map to the target model, with their multipliers
all_mapping_skus AS (
    -- Direct SKUs
    SELECT sku_id, 1 as sku_multiplier, model_qty
    FROM direct_skus
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs (the bundle itself maps to the model through its items)
    SELECT bundle_sku_id as sku_id, bundle_item_qty as sku_multiplier, model_qty
    FROM bundle_skus
),

-- Get all listings for these SKUs
relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, l.sku_id, ams.sku_multiplier, ams.model_qty
    FROM listing l
    JOIN all_mapping_skus ams ON l.sku_id = ams.sku_id
)

-- Calculate total units sold
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * rl.sku_multiplier * rl.model_qty), 0) as total_units_sold
FROM order_line ol
JOIN relevant_listings rl ON ol.listing_id = rl.listing_id
JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2025;
```

```sql
    FROM order_lines ol
```

```sql
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty,

        bi.qty as bundle_multiplier,
        ol.is_bundle

    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
```

```sql
-- For non-bundle SKUs: the SKU itself

        so.order_date,

    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN listing li ON so.listing_id = li.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON li.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs
    SELECT 
        se.order_id,
        se.order_date,
        se.line_no,
        se.listing_id,
        se.order_line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        se.original_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier,
        FALSE AS is_bundle
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON se.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE se.is_bundle = TRUE

-- Get models for each SKU (only for non-bundle items)
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        se.order_id,
        se.order_date,
        se.line_no,
        se.listing_id,
        se.order_line_qty,
        se.bundle_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN sku_model sm ON se.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE se.is_bundle = FALSE
      -- Also need to handle items that came from bundle expansion
      OR (se.is_bundle = FALSE AND se.sku_id = se.original_sku_id)
),
-- Deduplicate: for non-bundle direct SKUs, we have them once; for bundle items, we have them once
sku_models_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        se.order_id,
        se.order_date,
        se.line_no,
        se.listing_id,
        se.order_line_qty,
        se.bundle_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,

        smd.line_no,
        smd.listing_id,
        smd.order_line_qty,
        smd.bundle_multiplier,
        smd.model_qty,
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,

        be.bundle_multiplier,
        be.model_qty,
        c.component_id,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Anchor: start from the part itself
    SELECT 
        c.component_id AS root_id,
        c.component_code AS root_code,
        c.component_id AS child_id,
        c.component_code AS child_code,
        1.0 AS qty
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-998-OAK-02932'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find parents that consume this child
    SELECT 
        b.root_id,
        b.root_code,
        p.component_id,
        p.component_code,
        b.qty * e.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition e 
        ON e.child_kind = 'component' 
        AND e.child_code = b.child_code
    JOIN component p 
        ON p.component_code = e.parent_code
        AND p.is_assembly = true
    WHERE e.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

    SELECT DISTINCT child_code AS assembly_code, qty AS part_qty_per_assembly
    FROM bom
    WHERE child_code != 'FOO-998-OAK-02932'
),
-- Map assemblies to models

    SELECT 
        e.parent_code AS model_code,
        e.child_code AS component_code,
        e.qty AS component_qty_per_model
    FROM u_composition e
    WHERE e.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND e.child_kind = 'component'
      AND e.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        e.parent_code AS sku_code,
        e.child_code AS model_code,
        e.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition e
    WHERE e.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND e.child_kind = 'model'
      AND e.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Map bundle SKUs to item SKUs
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        e.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        e.child_code AS item_sku_code,

),

    FROM sku_models sm
```

```sql
      AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Map models to SKUs (non-bundle)
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        e.parent_code AS sku_code,
        e.child_code AS model_code,
        CAST(e.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition e
    WHERE e.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND e.child_kind = 'model'
      AND e.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Map bundle SKUs to item SKUs
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        e.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        e.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        CAST(e.qty AS DOUBLE) AS item_qty_per_bundle
    FROM u_composition e
    WHERE e.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND e.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND e.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Calculate part qty per SKU (handling bundles)
sku_part_qty AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_code,
        SUM(sm.model_qty_per_sku * mc.component_qty_per_model * ac.part_qty_per_assembly) AS part_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_components mc ON sm.model_code = mc.model_code
    JOIN assembly_components ac ON mc.component_code = ac.assembly_code
    GROUP BY sm.sku_code
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_code AS sku_code,
        SUM(bi.item_qty_per_bundle * inner_sm.model_qty_per_sku * mc.component_qty_per_model * ac.part_qty_per_assembly) AS part_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_models inner_sm ON bi.item_sku_code = inner_sm.sku_code
    JOIN model_components mc ON inner_sm.model_code = mc.model_code
    JOIN assembly_components ac ON mc.component_code = ac.assembly_code
    GROUP BY bi.bundle_sku_code
)
-- Sum total part consumption from completed orders at Amazon-CA-14 in 2024

JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku sku ON l.sku_id = sku.sku_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_model AS (
```
```sql
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Anchor: start from the bundle SKU, find its direct children (item SKUs)
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS code,
        c.child_kind AS kind,
        c.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-DE-0328'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand based on kind
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN t.kind = 'sku' THEN c2.child_code
            WHEN t.kind = 'model' THEN c3.child_code
            WHEN t.kind = 'component' AND comp.is_assembly = true THEN c4.child_code
        END AS code,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.kind = 'sku' THEN c2.child_kind
            WHEN t.kind = 'model' THEN c3.child_kind
            WHEN t.kind = 'component' AND comp.is_assembly = true THEN c4.child_kind
        END AS kind,
        t.qty * CASE 
            WHEN t.kind = 'sku' THEN c2.qty
            WHEN t.kind = 'model' THEN c3.qty
            WHEN t.kind = 'component' AND comp.is_assembly = true THEN c4.qty
        END AS qty
    FROM bom t
    -- SKU -> model
    LEFT JOIN u_composition c2 
        ON t.kind = 'sku' 
        AND c2.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND c2.parent_code = t.code
        AND c2.child_kind = 'model'
        AND c2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR c2.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    -- model -> component
    LEFT JOIN u_composition c3 
        ON t.kind = 'model' 
        AND c3.parent_kind = 'model' 
        AND c3.parent_code = t.code
        AND c3.child_kind = 'component'
        AND c3.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (c3.valid_to IS NULL OR c3.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    -- assembly component -> component
    LEFT JOIN component comp 
        ON t.kind = 'component' 
        AND t.code = comp.component_code
    LEFT JOIN u_composition c4 
        ON t.kind = 'component' 
        AND comp.is_assembly = true
        AND c4.parent_kind = 'component' 
        AND c4.parent_code = t.code
        AND c4.child_kind = 'component'
        AND c4.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (c4.valid_to IS NULL OR c4.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    WHERE 
        -- Continue only if we found a child
        CASE 
            WHEN t.kind = 'sku' THEN c2.child_code IS NOT NULL
            WHEN t.kind = 'model' THEN c3.child_code IS NOT NULL
            WHEN t.kind = 'component' AND comp.is_assembly = true THEN c4.child_code IS NOT NULL
            ELSE false
        END
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_model AS (
    -- Anchor: direct SKU to model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        bundle.parent_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        bundle.qty * sm.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition bundle
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON bundle.child_code = sm.sku_code
    WHERE bundle.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND bundle.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND bundle.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (bundle.valid_to IS NULL OR bundle.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
),
model_sales AS (

        sm.model_code,
        SUM(ol.qty * sm.qty) AS total_units

    JOIN sales_sku sku ON l.sku_id = sku.sku_id

    WHERE o.status = 'completed'

    GROUP BY sm.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
```

```sql
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,

    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-JP-0205'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand based on child kind
    SELECT 
        next.child_kind,
        next.child_code,
        bom.total_qty * next.qty as total_qty
    FROM bom
    JOIN u_composition next ON (
        -- If current is sku, expand to model or sku (bundle items)
        (bom.child_kind = 'sku' AND next.parent_kind = 'sku' AND next.parent_code = bom.child_code)
        OR
        -- If current is sku, expand to model

            JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = bom.child_code

            WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
              AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
            LIMIT 1
        ))
        OR
        -- If current is model, expand to component
        (bom.child_kind = 'model' AND next.parent_kind = 'model' AND next.parent_code = bom.child_code)

        -- If current is component (assembly), expand to component
        (bom.child_kind = 'component' AND next.parent_kind = 'component' AND next.parent_code = bom.child_code)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Anchor: start from the bundle SKU, find its direct child SKUs
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS code,
        c.child_kind AS kind,
        c.qty AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-JP-0037'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand based on kind
    SELECT 
        child.code,
        child.kind,
        bom.qty * child.qty AS qty,
        bom.level + 1
    FROM bom
    JOIN (
        -- SKU -> model edges
        SELECT 
            c.parent_code AS parent_code,
            'sku' AS parent_kind,
            c.child_code AS code,
            'model' AS kind,
            c.qty
        FROM u_composition c
        WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.child_kind = 'model'
          AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- model -> component edges
        SELECT 
            c.parent_code AS parent_code,
            'model' AS parent_kind,
            c.child_code AS code,
            'component' AS kind,
            c.qty
        FROM u_composition c
        WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model' AND c.child_kind = 'component'
          AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- assembly component -> component edges
        SELECT 
            c.parent_code AS parent_code,
            'component' AS parent_kind,
            c.child_code AS code,
            'component' AS kind,
            c.qty
        FROM u_composition c
        WHERE c.parent_kind = 'component' AND c.child_kind = 'component'
          AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    ) child ON bom.code = child.parent_code AND bom.kind = child.parent_kind
    WHERE bom.kind IN ('sku', 'model', 'component')
      -- Stop when we reach a part (non-assembly component)
      AND NOT (bom.kind = 'component' AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component comp 
          WHERE comp.component_code = bom.code AND comp.is_assembly = false
      ))
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bom.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom
JOIN component comp ON bom.code = comp.component_code
WHERE bom.kind = 'component'
  AND comp.is_assembly = false
```

```sql
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-CA-0221'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand based on kind
    SELECT 
        child.code,
        child.kind,
        bom.qty * child.qty AS qty,
        bom.level + 1
    FROM bom
    JOIN (
        -- From SKU to model (non-bundle SKUs)
        SELECT 
            c.parent_code AS parent_code,
            c.child_code AS code,
            c.child_kind AS kind,
            c.qty AS qty
        FROM u_composition c
        WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
          AND c.child_kind = 'model'
          AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- From model to component
        SELECT 
            c.parent_code AS parent_code,
            c.child_code AS code,
            c.child_kind AS kind,
            c.qty AS qty
        FROM u_composition c
        WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
          AND c.child_kind = 'component'
          AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- From assembly component to component
        SELECT 
            c.parent_code AS parent_code,
            c.child_code AS code,
            c.child_kind AS kind,
            c.qty AS qty
        FROM u_composition c
        WHERE c.parent_kind = 'component'
          AND c.child_kind = 'component'
          AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    ) child ON bom.code = child.parent_code AND bom.kind = (

            WHEN child.parent_code IN (SELECT model_code FROM company_model) THEN 'model'
            ELSE 'component'

    )

    WHERE bom.kind != 'component'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Anchor: find all models that directly contain the target component
    SELECT 
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        c.component_code AS child_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN company_model m ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = m.model_code
    JOIN component c ON uc.child_kind = 'component' AND uc.child_code = c.component_code
    WHERE c.component_code = 'MOT-367-WHT-00971'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: follow model -> assembly component -> sub-components
    SELECT 
        bom.model_id,
        bom.model_code,
        uc.child_code,
        bom.total_qty * uc.qty
    FROM bom
    JOIN component parent_comp ON parent_comp.component_code = bom.child_code
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'component' 
                          AND uc.parent_code = parent_comp.component_code
                          AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE parent_comp.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      -- Avoid cycles by not revisiting same (model, child) pair
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM bom b 
          WHERE b.model_id = bom.model_id 
            AND b.child_code = uc.child_code
      )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) FROM bom;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for completed orders in 2023 with their SKU codes
order_lines_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty,
        ol.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2023
),
-- Recursive CTE to expand SKUs to their leaf SKUs and then to models
-- For non-bundle SKUs: they map directly to models
-- For bundle SKUs: they contain item SKUs which then map to models
sku_expansion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with all SKUs from order lines
    -- For non-bundle SKUs, we'll track them as potential direct model mappers
    -- For bundle SKUs, we need to expand their contents
    SELECT 
        ol.qty as order_qty,
        ol.sku_code as root_sku_code,
        ol.sku_code as current_sku_code,
        ol.is_bundle,
        1 as bundle_multiplier,
        CASE WHEN ol.is_bundle = false THEN ol.sku_code ELSE NULL END as leaf_sku_code
    FROM order_lines_2023 ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand bundle SKUs into their child SKUs
    SELECT 
        se.order_qty,
        se.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_code as current_sku_code,
        cs.is_bundle,
        se.bundle_multiplier * uc.qty as bundle_multiplier,
        CASE WHEN cs.is_bundle = false THEN uc.child_code ELSE NULL END as leaf_sku_code
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON se.current_sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku cs ON uc.child_code = cs.sku_code
    WHERE se.is_bundle = true  -- Only expand if current node is a bundle
      AND se.leaf_sku_code IS NULL  -- Only expand if we haven't reached a leaf
),
-- Get leaf SKUs with their total bundle multipliers
leaf_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        order_qty,
        root_sku_code,
        leaf_sku_code,
        bundle_multiplier
    FROM sku_expansion
    WHERE leaf_sku_code IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION
    
    -- Also include non-bundle SKUs directly from order lines
    SELECT
        ol.qty as order_qty,
        ol.sku_code as root_sku_code,
        ol.sku_code as leaf_sku_code,
        1 as bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_lines_2023 ol
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false
),
-- Map leaf SKUs to company models
sku_to_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.order_qty,
        ls.root_sku_code,
        ls.leaf_sku_code,
        ls.bundle_multiplier,
        uc.child_code as model_code,
        uc.qty as model_qty
    FROM leaf_skus ls
    JOIN u_composition uc
        ON ls.leaf_sku_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
)
-- Calculate total units of the target model
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(sm.order_qty * sm.bundle_multiplier * sm.model_qty), 0) as total_units
FROM sku_to_models sm
WHERE sm.model_code = 'AE5-140WAL72-0654'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find all SKUs and their quantities that map to model NO5-140OAK03-0391
-- This includes direct mappings and mappings through bundles

-- Base: direct SKU -> model edges (non-bundle SKUs)
direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.qty as sku_to_model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model' AND c.child_code = 'NO5-140OAK03-0391'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
),

-- Bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs, and those item SKUs map to the target model
-- Need to find: bundle -> item SKU -> model
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,
        b.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        item.sku_id as item_sku_id,
        item.sku_code as item_sku_code,
        bc.qty as bundle_to_item_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition bc ON bc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND bc.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND bc.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_code = bc.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
        AND bc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (bc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= bc.valid_to)
),

-- Item SKUs in bundles that map to target model
bundle_item_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_sku_code,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_code,
        bi.bundle_to_item_qty,
        mc.qty as item_to_model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN u_composition mc ON mc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND mc.parent_code = bi.item_sku_code
        AND mc.child_kind = 'model' AND mc.child_code = 'NO5-140OAK03-0391'
    WHERE mc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (mc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mc.valid_to)
),

-- All SKUs that contribute to the model, with their per-SKU quantity to the model
all_contributing_skus AS (

    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        sku_to_model_qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM direct_sku_model
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle mappings: bundle SKU -> items -> model
    SELECT 
        bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        bundle_sku_code as sku_code,
        bundle_to_item_qty * item_to_model_qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_item_to_model

relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT 
        l.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        acs.model_qty_per_sku
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find all SKUs (including those inside bundles) that map to model VI1-140WHT65-0259
-- We need to expand bundles to their item SKUs, then find which SKUs map to the target model

-- Step 1: Get all SKU-to-model direct mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
),

-- Step 2: Recursive expansion of bundles to get leaf SKUs with their model mappings
bundle_expansion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with all SKUs, track if they came from a bundle
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        s.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        s.sku_id AS leaf_sku_id,
        s.sku_code AS leaf_sku_code,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM sales_sku s
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand bundle SKUs to their child SKUs
    SELECT 
        be.root_sku_id,
        be.root_sku_code,
        s.sku_id AS leaf_sku_id,
        s.sku_code AS leaf_sku_code,
        be.bundle_multiplier * c.qty AS bundle_multiplier,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM bundle_expansion be
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = be.leaf_sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_code = c.child_code
    WHERE be.is_bundle = true
),

-- Step 3: Get all leaf SKUs (non-bundle) from expansion, with their total multiplier from root
leaf_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        root_sku_id,
        root_sku_code,
        leaf_sku_id,
        leaf_sku_code,
        bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_expansion
    WHERE is_bundle = false
),

-- Step 4: Map leaf SKUs to models, combining with direct SKUs
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct non-bundle SKUs mapping to models
    SELECT 
        dsm.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        dsm.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        dsm.sku_id AS leaf_sku_id,
        dsm.sku_code AS leaf_sku_code,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier,
        dsm.model_code,
        dsm.model_qty
    FROM direct_sku_model dsm
    WHERE dsm.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle root SKUs mapped through their leaf SKUs
    SELECT 
        ls.root_sku_id,
        ls.root_sku_code,
        ls.leaf_sku_id,
        ls.leaf_sku_code,
        ls.bundle_multiplier,
        dsm.model_code,
        dsm.model_qty
    FROM leaf_skus ls
    JOIN direct_sku_model dsm ON dsm.sku_id = ls.leaf_sku_id
    WHERE dsm.is_bundle = false
),

-- Step 5: Get all SKUs (root) that ultimately map to target model with total quantity
target_model_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        root_sku_id,
        root_sku_code,
        SUM(bundle_multiplier * model_qty) AS units_per_sku
    FROM sku_to_model
    WHERE model_code = 'VI1-140WHT65-0259'
    GROUP BY root_sku_id, root_sku_code
),

-- Step 6: Get completed orders in 2025 with their line quantities
order_lines_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2025
)

-- Final: sum all units sold of SKUs that map to target model
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * tms.units_per_sku), 0) AS total_units_sold
FROM order_lines_2025 ol
JOIN target_model_skus tms ON tms.root_sku_id = ol.sku_id
```

```sql
            ELSE FALSE
```

```sql
sku_expansion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with all SKUs from order lines
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        osq.sku_code AS current_sku_code,
        osq.is_bundle,
        1 AS qty_multiplier,
        osq.sku_code AS leaf_sku_code,
        osq.is_bundle AS is_current_bundle
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand bundle SKUs to their child SKUs
    SELECT 
        se.listing_id,
        se.line_qty,
        se.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS current_sku_code,
        child_sk.is_bundle,
        se.qty_multiplier * uc.qty AS qty_multiplier,
        CASE WHEN child_sk.is_bundle = false THEN uc.child_code ELSE se.leaf_sku_code END AS leaf_sku_code,
        child_sk.is_bundle AS is_current_bundle
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN u_composition uc ON se.current_sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku child_sk ON uc.child_code = child_sk.sku_code
    WHERE se.is_current_bundle = true
),
-- Get leaf SKUs (non-bundle) with their total quantities
leaf_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        line_qty,
        root_sku_code,
        leaf_sku_code,
        qty_multiplier
    FROM sku_expansion
    WHERE is_current_bundle = false
      OR (root_sku_code = leaf_sku_code AND is_bundle = false)
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs directly (no expansion needed), also include them
direct_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        osq.sku_code AS leaf_sku_code,
        1 AS qty_multiplier
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        lsq.listing_id,
        lsq.line_qty,
        lsq.root_sku_code,
        lsq.leaf_sku_code,
        lsq.qty_multiplier
    FROM leaf_sku_qty lsq
),

sku_model_mapping AS (
    SELECT 
        dsq.listing_id,
        dsq.line_qty,

    FROM sku_model_mapping smm

FROM model_units
```

```sql
    -- Anchor: direct SKU to model edges (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        1 AS qty_multiplier,
        0 AS depth
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
                        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    JOIN company_model m ON c.child_code = m.model_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Anchor: bundle SKU to item SKU
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        NULL::INT AS model_id,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS model_code,
        c.qty AS qty_multiplier,
        1 AS depth
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
                        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.sku_code,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        sm.qty_multiplier * c.qty,
        sm.depth + 1
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
                        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    JOIN company_model m ON c.child_code = m.model_code
    WHERE sm.model_id IS NULL  -- only expand if we haven't reached a model yet
),
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find all SKUs that map to model SW4-120BLK46-0337, either directly or through bundles
model_to_sku_paths AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty_per_sku,
        1 AS sku_qty_per_path,  -- direct: 1 SKU contains the model
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_code = 'SW4-120BLK46-0337'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model paths
    SELECT 
        b.parent_code AS sku_code,
        m.child_code AS model_code,
        m.qty AS model_qty_per_sku,
        b.qty AS sku_qty_per_path,  -- bundle contains this many item SKUs
        GREATEST(b.valid_from, m.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN m.valid_to
            WHEN m.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, m.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM u_composition b
    JOIN u_composition m ON b.child_code = m.parent_code 
                        AND b.child_kind = 'sku' 
                        AND m.parent_kind = 'sku'
                        AND m.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE b.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND m.child_code = 'SW4-120BLK46-0337'
      -- Check date overlap for validity
      AND b.valid_from <= COALESCE(m.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
      AND COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') >= m.valid_from
),
-- Get total model quantity per SKU (summing over all paths)
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        sku_code,
        SUM(model_qty_per_sku * sku_qty_per_path) AS total_model_qty_per_sku
    FROM model_to_sku_paths
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY sku_code
),
-- Get all completed orders in 2024 with their SKUs
order_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        ss.sku_code
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON l.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
)
-- Calculate total model units sold
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that map directly to the model AL9-120BLK52-0634
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT ss.sku_id, ss.sku_code, 1.0 AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku ss
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = ss.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model' AND uc.child_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Find all bundle SKUs and their contained item SKUs that eventually map to the model
-- Start with all SKUs that are in bundles (as children)
bundle_contents AS (
    -- Anchor: direct composition edges from bundle SKU to item SKU
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS path_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: follow nested bundle contents (bundle inside bundle)
    SELECT 
        bc.bundle_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        bc.path_qty * uc.qty AS path_qty
    FROM bundle_contents bc
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = bc.item_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Map bundle item SKUs to the target model
bundle_model_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        bc.bundle_sku_code,
        bc.item_sku_code,
        bc.path_qty,
        uc2.qty AS model_per_sku_qty
    FROM bundle_contents bc
    JOIN u_composition uc2 ON uc2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc2.parent_code = bc.item_sku_code
        AND uc2.child_kind = 'model' AND uc2.child_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634'
        AND uc2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR uc2.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- All SKUs that map to the model, with total model quantity per SKU sold
all_model_skus AS (
    -- Direct mappings
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty AS total_model_qty FROM direct_skus
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle mappings: need to find sku_id for bundle SKUs
    SELECT ss.sku_id, bms.path_qty * bms.model_per_sku_qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM bundle_model_skus bms
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_code = bms.bundle_sku_code
),

    JOIN all_model_skus ams ON ams.sku_id = l.sku_id
```

```sql
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON l.sku_id = ss.sku_id

-- For non-bundle SKUs, they map directly to themselves (with qty 1)
sku_explosion AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map to themselves
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.sku_id,
        osl.sku_code,
        osl.order_line_qty,
        osl.sku_code AS item_sku_code,
        osl.sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        1.0 AS sku_qty
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    WHERE osl.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode to child SKUs using u_composition
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.sku_id,
        osl.sku_code,
        osl.order_line_qty,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        ss_child.sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        uc.qty::DOUBLE AS sku_qty
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = osl.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= osl.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR osl.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku ss_child ON ss_child.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE osl.is_bundle = true

    SELECT 
        se.order_id,
        se.order_date,
        se.sku_id,
        se.sku_code,
        se.order_line_qty,
        se.item_sku_code,
        se.item_sku_id,
        se.sku_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty::DOUBLE AS model_qty
    FROM sku_explosion se
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = se.item_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= se.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR se.order_date <= uc.valid_to)

        stm.order_date,
        stm.sku_id,
        stm.sku_code,
        stm.order_line_qty,
        stm.item_sku_code,
        stm.sku_qty,
        stm.model_code,
```

```sql
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'DE'
      AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2023
),
-- Get order lines with their SKU and quantity
order_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN de_orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode bundles to their item SKUs
-- For non-bundles, we keep the SKU itself
-- For bundles, we recursively expand to item SKUs
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Anchor: non-bundle SKUs (direct model mapping) and bundle items at first level
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN osq.is_bundle THEN uc.child_code
            ELSE osq.sku_code
        END AS item_sku_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN osq.is_bundle THEN osq.line_qty * uc.qty
            ELSE osq.line_qty
        END AS total_qty,
        osq.is_bundle
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    LEFT JOIN u_composition uc ON osq.is_bundle = true 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = osq.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2023-12-31'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2023-01-01')
    WHERE NOT osq.is_bundle OR uc.child_code IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand nested bundles
    SELECT 
        e.listing_id,
        e.line_qty,
        e.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        e.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        true AS is_bundle
    FROM exploded_skus e
    JOIN u_composition uc ON e.is_bundle = true
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.parent_code = e.item_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2023-12-31'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2023-01-01')
    WHERE e.item_sku_code IN (SELECT sku_code FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle = true)
),
-- Get leaf SKUs (non-bundle items)
leaf_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        line_qty,
        root_sku_code,
        item_sku_code,
        total_qty
    FROM exploded_skus e
    WHERE item_sku_code NOT IN (SELECT sku_code FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle = true)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include original non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        line_qty,
        sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        sku_code AS item_sku_code,
        line_qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty
    WHERE is_bundle = false
),
-- Map leaf SKUs to company models via composition
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.listing_id,
        ls.total_qty,
        ls.item_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM leaf_skus ls
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.parent_code = ls.item_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2023-12-31'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2023-01-01')
),
-- Calculate total model units sold
model_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        model_code,
        SUM(total_qty * model_qty) AS total_units
    FROM sku_to_model
    GROUP BY model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_totals
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
        END AS sku_multiplier
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    LEFT JOIN u_composition uc ON ss.sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= ol.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true OR (ss.is_bundle = false AND uc.child_code IS NULL)
),
-- Step 3: Get model composition for each SKU

    SELECT 
        si.order_id,
        si.line_no,
        si.line_qty,
        si.order_date,
        si.sku_multiplier,
        si.item_sku_code,
        uc2.child_code AS model_code,
        uc2.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_to_items si
    JOIN u_composition uc2 ON si.item_sku_code = uc2.parent_code
        AND uc2.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc2.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc2.valid_from <= si.order_date
        AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR si.order_date <= uc2.valid_to)

-- Step 4: Recursive explosion from model to components
model_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: models to their direct components
    SELECT

        sm.line_no,

        sm.order_date,

    JOIN u_composition uc ON me.component_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'

        me.total_qty,

    WHERE ap.is_assembly = false
)
```

```sql
-- Recursive CTE to handle bundle explosion
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: start with all SKUs from order lines
    SELECT 
        sq.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        sq.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        sq.sku_id AS current_sku_id,
        sq.sku_code AS current_sku_code,
        sq.line_qty AS order_qty,
        sq.line_qty AS accumulated_qty,
        sq.is_bundle,
        0 AS level
    FROM order_sku_qty sq
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode bundles through u_composition
    SELECT 
        e.root_sku_id,
        e.root_sku_code,
        child.sku_id AS current_sku_id,
        child.sku_code AS current_sku_code,
        e.order_qty,
        e.accumulated_qty * uc.qty AS accumulated_qty,
        child.is_bundle,
        e.level + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition uc ON e.current_sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku child ON uc.child_code = child.sku_code
    WHERE e.is_bundle = true

        root_sku_id,
        current_sku_id,
        current_sku_code,

    FROM exploded

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Non-bundle SKUs that were never expanded
    SELECT 
        sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        sku_id AS current_sku_id,
        sku_code AS current_sku_code,
```

```sql
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = uc.child_code
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for completed orders in JP in 2023 with their SKU quantities
order_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        l.sku_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        ol.qty * COALESCE(uc.qty, 1) AS sku_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON l.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = (SELECT sku_code FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_id = l.sku_id)
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= o.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND s.country = 'JP'
        AND extract('year' FROM o.order_date) = 2023
),
-- For bundle SKUs, explode to child SKUs
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        sq.sku_id,
        sq.sku_qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty sq
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON sq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: need to find child SKUs and multiply quantities
    -- Use u_explosion to get all SKU children of bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = ue.item_code) AS sku_id,
        sq.sku_qty * ue.qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty sq
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON sq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN u_explosion ue ON ue.root_kind = 'sku' 
        AND ue.root_code = ss.sku_code
        AND ue.item_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Now map SKUs to models
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 
            CASE 
                WHEN uc.child_kind = 'model' THEN uc.child_code
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS model_id,
        es.total_qty * COALESCE(uc.qty, 1) AS model_qty
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON es.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    LEFT JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = ss.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also need to handle the case where exploded_skus already came from bundles
    -- and we need to map those child SKUs to models
    SELECT 
        (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = uc.child_code) AS model_id,
        es.total_qty * COALESCE(uc.qty, 1) AS model_qty
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON es.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = ss.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
),
-- Aggregate by model
model_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        model_id,
        SUM(model_qty) AS total_units
    FROM sku_model_qty
    WHERE model_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY model_id
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_totals mt
JOIN company_model cm ON mt.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY mt.total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE as qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'AL8-140OAK56-0056'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-08-20'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-08-20')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        (b.qty * c.qty)::DOUBLE as qty,
        GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from) as valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END as valid_to
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = b.child_kind 
        AND c.parent_code = b.child_code
    WHERE b.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-08-20'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-08-20')

            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
```
